name: agent-leader-monorepo
description: Agent Leader 本地多智能体指挥系统（macOS / Windows 本地 C/S 双进程架构）

scripts.build: npm --workspace @agent-leader/protocol run build && npm --workspace @agent-leader/daemon run build && npm --workspace @agent-leader/web run build && npm --workspace @agent-leader/desktop run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @agent-leader/protocol run typecheck && npm --workspace @agent-leader/daemon run typecheck && npm --workspace @agent-leader/web run typecheck && npm --workspace @agent-leader/desktop run typecheck
